audit.why: Maokai is a low-damage sustain tank who owns the lane from 6 onward — the existing sides match the 52.56% win rate and 1,035 games.
audit.corrected: Kept; the timings were made concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 3-5 window was asserted without saying what closes it.
audit.why: Twisted Advance (W) is 14/13/12/11/10s. That cooldown, not a level, is the actual gate on whether your all-in lands, and it is short enough that "commit while it is down" is a real instruction.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] and mid now give the 14s figure and tie the commit to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The most punishing interaction in the matchup was missing: Maokai is UNTARGETABLE for the whole Twisted Advance dash.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target". An Aatrox who dumps Q1-Q2-Q3 into the dash loses the whole rotation for nothing. Bramble Smash also knocks back — it can displace you out of your own Q sweetspot, which the text called only a slow.
audit.corrected: mid and wants.you[1] now say to wait out the untargetable window; early states the Q knockback.

edits.before: You hold the edge at levels 1-2. Maokai's passive lets him drop saplings for free sustain and his Q Bramble Smash pokes and slows, but he has no hard commit until W Twisted Advance is up and he can't fight your brawl back. Trade for even-or-better CS, keep your E charges for the level 3 all-in or to dodge his root, and don't let his sapling sustain trick you into thinking the lane is even — press him while his tools are thin.
edits.after: You hold the edge at levels 1-2. Sap Magic heals him off an empowered auto and Bramble Smash (Q) knocks you back and slows on a 7s cooldown, but he has no hard commit until Twisted Advance is up and can't fight your brawl back. Trade for even-or-better CS, keep E charges for the level 3 all-in or to dodge the root, and don't let sapling sustain trick you — press him while his tools are thin.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 5 all favor you and this is your kill window: with your full Q pattern and E, land the Q3 sweetspot and drain him before his tank items make trades unwinnable. It only swings to Maokai at 6, where R Nature's Grasp adds a long-range engage that chain-CCs you into his W Twisted Advance root and signals a gank. Save E to dash out of his root, and never shove into an unwarded river once his ult is online.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 5 all favour you and this is your kill window: with your full Q pattern and E, land the Q3 sweetspot and drain him before tank items make trades unwinnable. Twisted Advance (W) is 14s and he is untargetable for the dash, so don't dump your combo into it — wait it out, then commit. It swings at 6, where Nature's Grasp adds a long-range root chaining into his W. Never shove an unwarded river once his ult is online.

edits.before: Dodge W Twisted Advance so he can't chain-CC your combo
edits.after: Wait out untargetable Twisted Advance, then commit

edits.before: Sustain through poke with passive sapling heals
edits.after: Sustain through poke with Sap Magic empowered autos

edits.before: These levels are your window: land Q3 sweetspot into E and out-drain him before his passive saplings and W root shut you down; commit while his W is on cooldown.
edits.after: These levels are your window: land Q3 sweetspot into E and out-drain him before his tank items land; commit while Twisted Advance is on its 14s cooldown, not while it is up.

notes: Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag that Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only), so no grounding claim was made in this slice.
